m-muok3w0ff6xr.bio: Tengo 26 años. Busco en un libro: To teach me something, philosophical and tough. Mis favoritos: Demian, In cold blood. I don't like love
m-muok3w0ff6xr.name: Johnn

b-muok5av1w0zy.about: I Who Have Never Known Men by Belgian author Jacqueline Harpman is a post-apocalyptic dystopian novel about 39 imprisoned women and one young girl living in an underground cage guarded by silent men.
b-muok5av1w0zy.author: Jacqueline Harpman
b-muok5av1w0zy.title: I Who Have Never Known Men

b-muok5av1w0zy~m-muok3w0ff6xr.comment: Bleak, existential, no romance to roll my eyes at. The narrator's detachment and the unanswered mysteries hit harder than answers would. Reminded me of Demian's isolation, honestly. Philosophical without being pretentious about it.

b-muolwmjv1hw2~m-muok3w0ff6xr.comment: Grandes tira de filosofía y dureza histórica, eso me engancha. La Guerra Civil cruda, sin romantizar. Aunque a veces se va por derroteros sentimentales que no necesita. Buena exploración de cómo la literatura nos salva.
